caption: The drawing depicts a large, shield-shaped badge with a dark border and predominantly gray and black shading. At the top center, there is a small, decorative circle; below it, the word "CENTRAL CITY" is written in bold, arching black letters across the upper portion of the badge. In the center of the badge is a large, stylized numeral "1" outlined in black, surrounded by ornamental linework. Underneath that, the text "SYRACUSE, N.Y." appears in bold, capital letters within a banner-like shape. The lower portion of the badge includes several lines of smaller, black handwritten text: “Contracting Committee,” followed by the names "W.D. Stewart, Mayor," "Edward H. Brown City Clerk," "John I. Crouse," "J. Bruyn," (listed as Aldermen), and "Philip Eckel Chief Engineer." The background of the badge is shaded in a gradient of grays, with heavier outlines and ornamental curves. The drawing is signed "Grant Vandervpool" in small script at the bottom right of the page. The badge is centered on a light tan or off-white background.
title: Engraved Name Plate
